title: Backend API and CLI
negative_results: an unsupported codec, a missing uncertainty, and a missing epoch are all typed ServiceError refusals
a malformed, unknown-codec, or non-string vector decodes to a typed REFUSAL (never a crash, never a guessed point)
a private token routed into an export receipt is refused before the bundle is sealed
malformed CLI args exit 2 (argparse); a rejected request exits 1 with a typed error object; decode of garbage is a typed refusal at exit 0

claims.statement: A framework-agnostic service layer (encode_point, decode_vector, legacy_search, round_trip, export_bundle, verify_vector) and a cw-atlas argparse CLI expose the reversible codecs and the legacy candidate search; every result carries CRS + epoch + claim class; no web framework is imported (POWER).

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic inputs only; exports privacy-scanned before sealing; no FastAPI/Flask imported; service asserts no geographic/physical claim
